nodes.question: How can information and communication technology be applied in the energy sector, as discussed in Erlenmeyer et al. (2016)?
nodes.answer: Information and communication technology can be applied in the energy sector for smart energy system simulation and control centre, as well as open-street-map-based power flow simulation, as discussed in Erlenmeyer et al. (2016).
